# ===================================================================
# CALL HIERARCHY — EVENT CHAIN EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates the Call Hierarchy feature (Shift+Alt+H).
# Place your cursor on any event ID and right-click > Peek Call Hierarchy
# to see what triggers it (Incoming) and what it fires (Outgoing).
#
# Event chain map:
#
#   on_yearly_pulse ──┐
#                     ├──> adventure.0001 ──> adventure.0002 ──> adventure.0003
#   start_adventure ──┘        │                                     │
#     (decision)               │                                     │
#                              └──> adventure.0004                   │
#                                                                    │
#                              adventure.0001 <──────────────────────┘
#                                (circular back-reference)
#
# Scripted effect/trigger cross-references:
#   adventure.0001 calls  grant_adventure_rewards (scripted effect)
#   adventure.0004 calls  grant_adventure_rewards (scripted effect)
#   adventure.0001 checks is_adventure_eligible   (scripted trigger)
#   adventure.0004 checks is_adventure_eligible   (scripted trigger)
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

namespace = adventure

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 1: Adventure begins — entry point
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: on_yearly_pulse (on-action), start_adventure (decision),
#                 adventure.0003 (circular back-reference)
# OUTGOING CALLS: adventure.0002, adventure.0004,
#                 grant_adventure_rewards (scripted effect)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
adventure.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = adventure.0001.t
	desc = adventure.0001.desc
	theme = adventure

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_available = yes
		is_adventure_eligible = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = adventurer
		grant_adventure_rewards = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = adventure.0001.a
		# Continue the chain — fires adventure.0002
		trigger_event = {
			id = adventure.0002
			days = 30
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = adventure.0001.b
		# Branch — fires adventure.0004 directly
		trigger_event = adventure.0004
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 2: Mid-chain event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: adventure.0001
# OUTGOING CALLS: adventure.0003, log_adventure_progress (scripted effect)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
adventure.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = adventure.0002.t
	desc = adventure.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_alive = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		log_adventure_progress = yes
		trigger_event = adventure.0003
	}

	option = {
		name = adventure.0002.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 3: Circular reference event
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: adventure.0002
# OUTGOING CALLS: adventure.0001 (circular — back to start!)
#
# Try Call Hierarchy here to see the circular chain visualised:
#   adventure.0001 -> 0002 -> 0003 -> 0001
# CodeLens should also flag the circular reference warning.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
adventure.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = adventure.0003.t
	desc = adventure.0003.desc

	immediate = {
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = adventurer_modifier
			years = 2
		}
	}

	after = {
		# Circular: chains back to 0001
		trigger_event = adventure.0001
	}

	option = {
		name = adventure.0003.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Event 4: Leaf event — no outgoing event calls
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: adventure.0001, grant_adventure_rewards (scripted effect)
# OUTGOING CALLS: (none — uses is_adventure_eligible scripted trigger only)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
adventure.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = adventure.0004.t
	desc = adventure.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adventure_eligible = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = adventure.0004.a
		add_prestige = 200
		add_gold = 500
	}
}
